svg.title: Passive optical network: topology
svg.desc: Follow the numbered physical path: 1 OLT port, 2 feeder fiber, 3 primary passive splitter, 4 distribution fiber, 5 secondary splitter if used or serving terminal, 6 drop fiber, and 7 ONT/ONU. Bidirectional arrows represent upstream and downstream service. OLT headend electronics are at a central office or hub; ONT/ONU devices are at customer or remote endpoints. Passive splitters divide optical power without powered outside-plant electronics. A single-stage design can omit the secondary split.

g.text: A typical OLT-to-customer path; splitter staging depends on the network design

g.text: Splitters divide optical power without powered electronics.
Single-stage designs can omit the secondary split.
ONT/ONU: customer premises or a remote endpoint.
